decisionAuthority.name: Jerome
decisionAuthority.mechanism: Repository-recorded independent decision; no cryptographic-signature claim

rationale: A1 requires both exact done-tree reconstructions and rebuilt test commands to pass with zero failed, skipped, or not-run tests.
The Story 6.2 exact done tree executed 431 conformance tests with 429 passed, 2 failed, and 0 skipped.
The failures prove that seven root gitlinks moved after the recorded promotion-proof candidate, so the historical completion evidence cannot be accepted or superseded as passing.
preserves: All root submodule content and gitlinks
nonClaims: This decision does not rewrite or invalidate Git history.
This decision does not lift the implementation hold.
This decision does not authorize IR-0, Story 7.1, a successor, or release.
